recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, white-background ensemble portrait featuring a diverse group of characters in formal attire gathered around a paradoxical centerpiece: a wooden coffin draped in a white wedding tablecloth. The scene is surreal and humorous, featuring a sheep in the foreground and confetti in the air, topped with elegant, staggered serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the solemnity of a coffin and the celebration of a wedding
Staggered vertical hierarchy of text and image
Isolation of subjects against a stark white void
Visual weight balanced by the sheep in the lower right foreground
coreInvariants: Formal attire (tuxedos, wedding dresses, priest robes)
Juxtaposition of life events (marriage and death symbols)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Characters are arranged in a horizontal line across the middle third of the frame; typography occupies the top third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white-draped coffin serves as the central horizontal anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large title text, move down to the central couple, then sweep left to the priest and right to the dancing figure, finally resting on the sheep.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space at the top and bottom creates a clean, airy, and theatrical feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background and tablecloth) providing a neutral, high-contrast canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark charcoal (suits and priest robes) for sharp silhouettes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm wood tones from the coffin and muted floral colors.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Naturalistic skin tones and fabric colors against a desaturated, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a realistic, slightly warm photographic palette

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal bars extending from specific letters (e.g., F and A) to underline or overline adjacent text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal strokes on the 'F' in the first word and 'A' in the third line to create framing lines.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Small, wide-tracked sans-serif or light serif for metadata text at the very top and bottom.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule lines integrated into letterforms

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classical, elegant foundation for the display text.
To replicate the extended horizontal bars.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a photographic collage on a pure white background. In the center, place a polished wooden coffin partially covered by a white linen tablecloth. Arrange a group of 6-8 people in 1990s formal wedding attire (tuxedos, floral dresses) behind the coffin. Include a priest on the left and a man jumping joyfully on the right. Place a fluffy sheep with a small pink bow in the lower right foreground. Add a light dusting of colorful confetti in the air.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of all-caps serif text at the top. The first word should be centered with a line extending from the top of the first letter. The second word should be slightly offset. The third line should include an ampersand and a word with a line extending from the bottom of the 'A'. Use a dark charcoal color and wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Does the typography feature the characteristic horizontal bars?
